'''2017 MPC Barry Alperstein DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2017 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Player:''' [[Barry Alperstein]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 Match Play Championship]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
